name: Szarvasgede (Hungary)
description: Green field with a white triangle at the hoist whose point reaches the fly, charged in the triangle with the municipal arms of Szarvasgede: a green shield with a stag and a ploughshare, above a scroll inscribed SZARVASGEDE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
